reached_sql:
WITH mv_top_sellers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sum(coalesce(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM date_dim
    JOIN store_sales
        ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN item
        ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN store
        ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id
    )
),
mv_top_sellers_ranked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i_category
            ORDER BY sumsales DESC
        ) AS rk
    FROM mv_top_sellers
),
mv_top_sellers_final AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        rk
    FROM mv_top_sellers_ranked
    WHERE rk <= 100
)
SELECT *
FROM mv_top_sellers_final
ORDER BY
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
LIMIT 100
